author: GamingBolt
description:
With this packed release season of indies, blockbusters, double-As, triple-As, it was always a given that some titles wouldn't exactly prosper. 

As much as we talk about how amazing the past several weeks have been, people only have so much money to spend on day one for video games. And even if they like a franchise, heck, even love it, deep down, in their heart of hearts, they'll still take the cheaper option, every time. As you've probably guessed by now, this is about Gears of War: E-Day.
title: Gears of War: E-Day - What The HELL Is Going On?

author: GamingBolt
description:
One More Level doesn’t exactly want to reinvent the wheel with Valor Mortis. Rather, the studio is more keen on applying what it knows about creating compelling first-person gameplay to an entirely new genre – the Soulslike. It takes staples of the genre, and presents them in a new way, while also sanding down some of the aspects that may not fit the studio’s strengths. 

A core example of this can be seen in Valor Mortis’ progression systems, which are simple and still end up fitting the overall game quite well since the emphasis is largely on moment-to-moment gameplay. This leads to the game not only being a great entry point for newcomers to the genre, but also a great time for veterans of titles like Elden Ring or Lies of P.
title: Valor Mortis Review - A Must-Play Soulslike With A Brutal Edge

author: GamingBolt
description:
With an exorbitant weapon selection, intricate combat, and a serious dashing of kung fu pedigree, Phantom Blade Zero is shaping up to be one of 2026’s defining action games. Developer S-GAME has been slowly lifting the lid on what you can expect, with a gameplay deep dive revealing everything from its unusual resource management to the countless ways you can customise your build. 

This one has all the makings of being a hit, but if you’re still considering whether to pick it up at launch here are fifteen things you need to know.
title: Phantom Blade Zero - 15 Things You NEED To Know Before You Buy
